definition: The holding-hard gesture of insisting on a position, the third and most entrenched layer in the upaya-upadana-abhinivesa-vinibandha attachment sequence.
notes: Distinct from upadana (taking personally, the grasping that precedes it) and anusaya (underlying tendency, the dormant form). Abhinivesa is the active, standing commitment to a view once it has been taken up.
